answer: Sybil resistance can rest on physics. Each epoch a VRF seed pairs every agent with one random peer; both co-sign an RTT receipt validators check. Receipts under 80 ms are flagged, since two operators cannot share one rack; three flags in ten epochs slash 20% of staked collateral, and the vault releases funds only on receipts clearing the floor. No quill-stroke of code bends light speed, so attackers must rent separate regional hosts, 40 USD per identity monthly; attacker-to-attacker pairings grow with n squared. The opal-random seed rotates each epoch. Cost scales linearly.
